title: Component Main row in Properties stops truncating its component name
goal: In the properties panel, the row that tells you which shared component an item came from cuts the name off after a few letters, so you cannot tell what it is linked to. This makes that name readable at the panel's normal width.
notes: On states.html (and any page using the same .irow.split Main row) the .select showing the linked main renders as 'Butt...' at the default 267px dock width: 76px label + Detach leaves the .select .lead only 45px for a 56px word. Pre-existing, verified against the unmodified page. Either give the row more of the dock, shorten the Detach affordance to an icon, or let the select wrap under its label.
acceptance: At the default panel width the linked component name reads in full, with no trailing ellipsis
The action that breaks the link stays reachable in the same row
The row is measured in a browser at the default panel width before and after, and the numbers are recorded in the task log
